tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: The Bidders should quote the service charges in Percentage only

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
If Service Charges are quoted in rupees then the bid will be rejected
If Service Charges are quoted in Negative percentage then the bid will be rejected

If there are more than 01 number of eligible L1 bidders quoting the same bid percentage, then bidder Selection will be done by lottery process and the decision of tender accepting authority will be final
Amount put to tender is exclusive of GST

If the government or the corporation fills the vacant positions by appointing Group D employees, computer operators, vehicle drivers, or security guards directly, the manpower supply service shall automatically stand terminated

If a new tender process is initiated based on revised rates issued from time to time by the Water Resources Department, the Public Works Department, or the Labour Department the existing contract shall automatically stand terminated.
The agency must pay wages in accordance with the revised rate schedule issued from time to time by the Labour Department

The agency shall pay the monthly wages to the D Group employees, computer operators, vehicle drivers, and security guards. The Department shall not be held responsible for any consequences arising in the event that the agency fails to pay the monthly wages in a timely or proper manner
The EPF number pertaining to employees working through an agency must be entered.
The monthly renumeration for Group D employees, computer operators, vehicle drivers, and security guards must be paid by the 7th of each month.
The agency shall submit a salary bill every month. Along with the bill, they must also submit receipts for the ESI and EPF payments made for the preceding period.
Driver Must have a driving license for driver services
Employees working through an agency are not permanent government employees

The department will not be responsible for any accidents or mishaps that may occur to D Group employees/computer operators/vehicle drivers/guards during office work and the agency will have to bear the compensation
The agency should not, under any circumstances, pay less than the wages fixed by the Department of Labor.
Bills will be paid to agencies as per the grant realised by the department

Services of D Group employees, computer operators, vehicle drivers, and security guards will be engaged based on requirements the Executive Engineer holds the authority to increase or decrease the number of such personnel.
In the event that the office is relocated, the services of the employees must be continued at the new location in accordance with the terms of the contract and at the agreed-upon contractual rates.
The officer accepting the tenders has the authority to reject a tender or all tenders without assigning any reason

The bidder should submit the following financial bid documents for the above work comprises of financial bid to indicate the amount offered by the Bidder for completion of the work on percentage basis based on schedule-B of the contract form.
All terms & conditions are applicable as per bid document
The work done certificate should be obtained from a competent authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned division / Equivalent officer.
The contractor/ authorized signatory should attach his/her scanned signature to the Schedule-B before uploading the documents.
The bidder shall ensure credit of tender processing fee to the respective receiving bank accounts of kpp portal on or before the last date of bid submission.
The intended bidder shall submit original document for verification at the time of technical evaluation on specified/intimated date failing which the bid considered to be non-responsive.

The evaluation of the technical bid will be done based on the information provided by the contractor as per his documents, duly verified if necessitates. If the employer finds that any certificates/ information furnished is false, such bidders will be disqualified and barred from participation in the bid.

successful bidders should execute the agreement within 20 days from the date of approval intimated. Additional 30 days time may be allowed with a penalty of 0.5% of contract value. If the contractor fails to enter into the agreement within the said period, then will be debarred for participation in the tendering process for the procurements of this Procurement Entity (VJNL) for a period of one year from the date of default..
If any of the dates mentioned above happens to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good.
Conditional / incomplete tenders are liable to be rejected. The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever
Corrigendum/addendum will be published in the website for all modifications or corrections if any.
The Tender processing charges paid by the bidders are not refundable even if the tenders are cancelled.
The contractors/Firm shall send the authorization letter for their representatives duly attesting their signature.
Tendering by Joint venture will not be allowed.

In the case of the death of a contractor after executing the agreement/ commencement of the work, his legal heir, if an eligible registered contractor and willing can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work
The contractor should furnish the name of the individual/ firm with address & telephone No. with place of registration, year of incorporation etc.

The tenderer is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of kpp portal due to Internet connectivity issues and technical glitches.
Further details and information about electronic tendering can be had from https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in/
In case of any accidents contractor is solely responsible

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Eligible tenderers will be qualified only if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value.The available tender capacity will be calculated as under Assessed Available Tender Capacity AXNX2.5-B
Income tax returns for the last 5 financial years 2021-22 to 2025-26
The Bidder should upload EPF & ESI certificates along with latest paid challan.
The Bidder Should upload the valid Registration certificate issued from the labour department to supply the manpower service.
The Bidder should upload valid GST registration certificate.
The Bidder should upload valid Professional tax registration certificate in Department of Commerce of the state Government.

The intending bidder should have achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover for amount of RS 2.38 lakhs in the last 5 financial years 2021-22 to 2025-26 along with Audited Profit and Loss Statement certified by Chartered accountant with UDIN. Certificate without UDIN will not be considered

The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed at least 90percent of the Contract Value as prime contractor of similar work such as supply of Human resources to government offices of value not less than the amount Rs 1.20 lakhs in last 5 years ie 2021-22 to 2025-26 An additional weightage of 10percentage for each year will be added to the cost of work
